title: Filter Coffee Strength
body: Filter coffee is made by mixing coffee decoction with milk. In Lakshmi's coffee shop, a regular cup is made by mixing 15 mL of coffee decoction with 35 mL of milk, so the ratio of decoction to milk is 15 : 35. When a customer asks for stronger coffee, she uses more decoction for the same amount of milk, so the ratio of decoction to milk is greater than in the regular cup. For lighter coffee she uses less decoction for the same amount of milk. To decide whether a mix is regular, strong or light, she writes each ratio in its simplest form and compares it with the regular ratio.
